wa.shop.orders_on.text: Orders don on: customers fit order from your page, and each order go come meet you here.

wa.shop.orders_tail.text: Reply *order* and di reference for one.

wa.shop.other_edits_live.text: Other changes wey you save for your page but never publish don go live with am.

wa.shop.page_draft.text: *{name}* na draft, e never publish. Reply *publish* to put am online.

wa.shop.page_suspended.text:
The page of {name} don suspend: {reason}
To explain, send APPEAL and your message.

wa.shop.page_turned_down.text:
Taskiem no fit put the page of {name} live: {reason}
Change am and send PUBLISH again, or send APPEAL and your message.

wa.shop.photo_bad.text: We no fit use dat photo ({reason}). Send JPEG or PNG wey no pass 10 MB.

wa.shop.photo_caption.text: To add product with dis photo, send am again with di name and price as caption, like *Jollof rice 2000*.

wa.shop.photo_failed.text: We no fit store dat photo now. Try again after one minute.

wa.shop.photo_not_now.text: I no fit take photo now. Finish wetin we dey do, or reply *cancel*.

wa.shop.photo_rejected.text: Dem no accept dat photo for public page. Nothing add.

wa.shop.photos_off.text: Photos no fit store here yet, so nothing add. Send di product without photo: *add product Jollof rice 2000*.

wa.shop.pick_again.text:
Reply with one number from di list:
{list}

wa.shop.product_exists.text: *{name}* don already dey your product list for {price}. Change di price with *price* and di name.

wa.shop.product_how.text: Write am like *add product Jollof rice 2000*: di name, then di price (2000, ₦2,000 or 2k).

wa.shop.publish_failed.text: We no fit publish your page: {reason}

wa.shop.publish_hint.text: Reply *publish* to put your page online.

wa.shop.published.text:
Your page don dey online: {link}
QR code and status text to paste dey come. Add products with *add product Jollof rice 2000*, or send photo with caption *Jollof rice 2000*.

wa.shop.qr_print.text: Print card wey get dis code for your counter: {url}

wa.shop.ready_failed.text: We no fit tell di customer say order {ref} don ready: {reason}

wa.shop.ready_sent.text: We dey tell di customer say order {ref} don ready. Reply *order {ref} delivered* when dem collect am.

wa.shop.reopens.text: E go open again by itself for {time}.

wa.shop.service_hint.text: Customers fit book am once bookings don on: reply *turn on orders*.

wa.shop.service_how.text: Write am like *add service Haircut 30 2000*: di name, di minutes e dey take, then di price.

wa.shop.setup_start.text: Make we create your page. Five short questions; reply *cancel* to stop anytime.

wa.shop.status.price_changed.text: dey wait make customer agree di new prices

wa.shop.too_many.text: Na plenty changes at once. Wait small, then reply *yes* again.

wa.shop.turn_on_orders.text: Make I on orders now? Customers go fit order from your page, and each order go come meet you here make you accept or decline.

wa.signin.link.text:
Open this link make you choose your password and enter Taskiem for web. E go work once, for one hour; no give anybody:
{link}

wa.signin.sso.text: Your organisation dey sign in with their company account: {link}

wa.signin.unavailable.text: Sign in for web never set up for this Taskiem.

wa.status.denied.text: You no fit see runs for {org} (you need run.read).

wa.status.none.text: No run for the last 24 hours.

wa.status.waiting.text: {count} approval dey wait for you: send *approvals*.

wa.stepup_waiting.text: Your decision on {step} dey wait make you confirm am for Taskiem with the link wey we send you. Send *cancel* to drop am.

wa.table.add_failed.text:
The row no enter: {reason}

Reply *yes* to try again or *cancel*.

wa.table.add_what.text: Send *add to* and the table name.

wa.table.cancelled.text: I don cancel am. Nothing enter.

wa.table.confirm_reminder.text: Reply *yes* make I add the row to {table}, or *cancel*.

wa.table.denied_edit.text: You no fit add rows for {org} (you need table.edit).

wa.table.denied_now.text: You no fit add rows for {org} again.

wa.table.denied_read.text: You no fit see data tables for {org} (you need table.read).

wa.table.find_more.text: … and {count} more. Find with more words, or open Tables for Taskiem.

wa.table.find_no_column.text: {table} no get text column wey I fit search. Send *find*, the table and column:text.

wa.table.find_what.text: Send *find*, the table name and wetin you dey find.

wa.table.form.text: {table}: tap *{cta}* to enter the {count} detail(s) for the row; you go confirm before I add am. Send *cancel* to stop.

wa.table.form_more.text:
Thank you. {count} more to enter here. Send *cancel* to stop.

{prompt}

wa.table.gone.text: {table} don change while you dey add to am. Send *add to* again.

wa.table.hint.phone.text: One phone number with the country code, like 2348012345678

wa.table.kept.text: Na Taskiem dey keep {table}: na only Taskiem dey add rows, you no fit change or delete dem for here. Correction na new row.

wa.table.list_tail_add.text: Send *add to* and the table name to add one row.

wa.table.list_tail_find.text: Send *find*, the table name and one word to look for rows.

wa.table.needs_values.text:
I dey add one row to {table} ({count} column(s)). Send *cancel* to stop.

{prompt}

wa.table.no_match.text: No data table match {name}. Send *tables* to see dem.

wa.table.none.text: {org} never get any data table. Create one for Taskiem, under Tables{link}.

wa.table.not_added.text: The row no enter {table}: {reason}. Send *add to* again.

wa.table.optional.text: (no be must: send *skip* to leave am empty)

wa.table.pick_again.text:
Send one number from the list, or *cancel*:
{list}

wa.table.too_many.text: You don add plenty rows just now. Wait one minute, then try again.

wa.table.unavailable.text: Data tables no dey reachable now. Try again after one minute.

wa.too_fast.text: You dey send message too fast. Wait small, then try again.

wa.unbound.text: This number never join any Taskiem account. To use Taskiem here, sign in, open {where}, add this number under WhatsApp, then type or send back the code wey we go send you.

wd.approval.role_many.text: Ask {count} people wey get {role} role make dem approve

wd.capability.text: {what} with any payments account wey dey connected

wd.foreach.text: For each thing for the list:

wd.foreach_limited.text: For each thing for the list (no pass {count} at once):

wd.form.email.text: Ask person for him email address make e fill “{title}”

wd.form.phone.text: Ask person for him phone number make e fill “{title}”

wd.form.role.text: Ask members wey get {role} role make dem fill “{title}”

wd.schedule.hourly.text: Every hour, as the hour reach

wd.schedule.last_day.text: For the last day of every month by {time} ({tz} time)

wd.schedule.monthly.text: For day {day} of every month by {time} ({tz} time)

wd.schedule.weekdays.text: Every working day (Monday to Friday) by {time} ({tz} time)

wd.transform.text: Arrange the data for the next steps

wd.trigger.database_change.text: When one row for database change

wd.trigger.form_link.text: When person fill the form “{title}” (only with link wey we send am)

wd.trigger.form_members.text: When person fill the form “{title}” (na only members)

wd.trigger.storefront.text: When person send the shop {form} form

wd.trigger.ussd.text: When person dial the USSD code

wd.trigger.webhook.text: When your system call this workflow web address

wd.trigger.webhook_checked.text: When your system call this workflow web address (we check am with {auth})

wd.trigger.webhook_unsigned.text: When your system call this workflow web address (no signature check)

wd.wait_until.text: Wait reach the time wey dem set
